design: Leave each task out of fitting. Train prefix context differences on old wording (template1) from the other four tasks, 32 endpoint vectors. Evaluate held-out task/new wording (template3), eight endpoints x six signed signals. Fit fixed mean, mean direction, uncentered PCA8/32 and seeded random8/32 controls. Same-task-old-wording rank8 is a separate diagnostic and not task holdout. Per-case oracle8/32 sees response targets. Reused H603 panel; adaptive cross-validation, not independent confirmation.
rank_rule: Exclude singular values <=1e-6 of largest; shared32 means up to32, same_task8 means up to8, random32 matched to effective shared rank. Repeated capital prompts create exact dependencies.
scope: Predict one prefix edit response in MLP11. Projection modes still observe actual dc; only fixed_mean predicts dc without case-specific context difference. All modes use observed incoming e. Same lexical items across wording; task folds not independent corpus samples. No semantic-unit or global compression claim.
